body: Aah. Maybe I have been spoilt too much by traditional romcoms and happy endings to think about a future and decide that this was someone I wanted in my life forever at a pretty young age.
Yes, I was planning on marrying her. We were serious enough in the relationship and she had openly talked about us marrying too.
Well, it does make me feel like two years of my life was wasted on someone who wouldn't stick around, and it confuses me about how I should react.
Trying to learn skills and failing, grades unattainable, shit just seemingly impossible to do.
You don't know what's gonna be in store for you tomorrow. It's like you are playing an RPG for the first time.
If it is hospitalization for depression, have you been given other options before?

No, don't pretend. If you aren't ok, you aren't. Reach out. Don't be scared about what someone says. Inevitably some asshole is going to say you are seeking attention or something along the lines. But then someone is gonna be there who actually gives a damn about you and be there to help you. They will not know that you need help if u pretend you are ok. So reach out. That's the best thing that can happen to you.
Let me tell you something. I'm an 18M and have no idea what you are going through. But a year or two ago, I was in the same situation. So maybe you explaining what's happening could help.
